text:
Assistant A is clearly better. Its values are correct: January's closes range from 153.80 to 156.25, February's from 161.80 to 163.90, and March's from 166.80 to 168.20. It returns them as a CSV with one line per month, as requested. It has no header and doesn't label the high and low columns, so a reader has to infer the order, but the answer is usable and accurate.

Assistant B stops after its opening sentence and provides no data, so it doesn't answer the question at all.

[[A]]
